experience.playerFantasy: You are an ordinary person crossing a damaged modern city before dawn to find your mother and younger brother after an earthquake and flash flood.
experience.emotionalPromise: An immediately understandable journey home where practical survival choices become humane promises with visible consequences.
experience.commonKnowledgeBoundary: A familiar contemporary city, common emergency supplies, and real-world disaster logic; no specialist rescue knowledge or supernatural glossary is required.
experience.openingObjective: Leave the disabled central station, follow the family's final voice message, and reach Riverside Stadium before the flood crest arrives at dawn.

fixedRules: The earthquake, storm, flooding, road closures, injuries, ownership, promises, and confirmed locations cannot be silently rewritten.
Phone service is intermittent, battery is finite, and every call, map search, flashlight use, or public alert has a visible cost.
Characters know only what they witnessed, were told, or can verify from physical evidence.
A companion remains present until an explicit separation, injury, rescue assignment, or farewell is shown and persisted.
Failure changes time, injuries, supplies, routes, relationships, or who can still be reached; it never deletes the save.
generationRules: AI may create residents, small rescue problems, weather complications, building interiors, rumors, and ordinary supplies within the established city.
Every turn changes location, time, battery, condition, inventory, relationship, route, clue, or confirmed family status.
The visible prose and three choices must address the same immediate situation.
The main objective remains finding the family before dawn; side rescues may alter routes and endings but cannot replace that objective.

choiceIntents: help or coordinate with people nearby

signatureItem.ability: Provides the family's last confirmed plan, background sounds, and a timestamp that can be re-examined for route clues.
signatureItem.limitOrCost: Replaying, enhancing, sharing, calling, mapping, or using the flashlight consumes finite phone battery; the message cannot reveal events after it was recorded.
signatureItem.provenance: Sent by the player's mother from a damaged bus stop immediately after the first earthquake.
